name: Fan coil units (FCU)
tagline: Room-level comfort from a central chilled-water plant
description: Compact terminal units that use chilled water from a central chiller to cool individual rooms and zones.
long_description: A fan coil unit pulls room air across a chilled-water coil and blows it back into the space. Each FCU has its own thermostat, so hotel rooms, cabins and wards can be controlled individually while the main cooling comes from a central chiller plant. FCUs come as ceiling-concealed, cassette, wall-mounted and floor-standing models.
features: Individual room control on a central chilled-water system
Concealed, cassette, wall and floor-standing styles
Quiet operation with EC motor options
considerations: Needs a central chiller and chilled-water piping
Condensate drain and valve access must be planned for each unit
EC motors cut fan energy and noise in hotel rooms

faqs.question: Can FCUs be added to an existing chiller?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, if the chiller and pumps have spare capacity. We check the plant before recommending new FCUs.

faqs.question: Do you service FCUs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Filter cleaning, coil washing, drain tray cleaning, motor checks and valve servicing are all part of our AMC.
